arch: feature folders (feature/api,ui,model) - apps over type folders
barrel files only at feature roots - avoid export spaghetti
API client layer with typed errors - no raw fetch in components
monorepo workspaces for shared code - version together
description: Write strict TypeScript with no-explicit-any, discriminated unions, and vitest proof. Use for any TypeScript code or review.
idioms: strict true, narrow with type guards never blind casts
discriminated unions plus exhaustive switch for states
async await with explicit error boundaries
readonly data by default, as const for literals
name: typescript-code
pitfalls: any leaking through boundaries - type at IO edges
non-null assertion chains - guard or handle
floating promises - await or handle explicitly
enums for data - prefer union literals
style: strict mode, no explicit any in new code
unknown plus narrowing instead of any
named exports over default except entry points
testing: vitest for units, testing-library for UI; test behavior, not implementation.
triggers: setting up TypeScript builds, lint, or tests
